# Feature: Fetz 3D real canvas snapshot capture

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-07-28 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
`requestEngineSnapshot` schreibt bei offenem Engine-Preview eine echte WebGL/Canvas-Capture (`toDataURL`) in den In-Memory-Cache; 1×1-PNG-Stub nur als Fallback ohne Canvas / bei Capture-Fehler. Max ein Live-Canvas bleibt.

Roadmap: Fetz 3D follow-up (Stufe B) — Issue #146. Feature slug: `fetz-3d-real-snapshot`.

## Preconditions
- #145 merged: shared `EnginePreviewCanvas` under `src/components/engine3d/`
- #134: in-memory cache + `requestEngineSnapshot(recipe, { canvas? })` API exists
- Play `EnginePreviewPanel` mounts one preview canvas

## Happy Path
- [ ] Live R3F canvas exposes `HTMLCanvasElement` to Play panel (`onGlCanvasReady`)
- [ ] `preserveDrawingBuffer` enabled so `toDataURL` is non-blank after composite
- [ ] Panel **Snapshot cachen** passes live canvas (+ `force`) → source `canvas` → cache by `createRenderKey`
- [ ] Same `renderKey` → subsequent call source `cache`
- [ ] DE Status-Texte unterscheiden Cache / Canvas / Stub / Miss
- [ ] Capture-Pfad in `docs/engine-system/rendering.md` (+ asset-pipeline note)
- [ ] Vitest: canvas hit + throw→placeholder + force overwrite; `npm run checks` grün; typed-strict

## Edge Cases
- [ ] No WebGL / no canvas → placeholder (button) or miss (`allowPlaceholder: false`); no crash
- [ ] `toDataURL` throws (tainted) → stub fallback when allowed
- [ ] Unmount clears canvas callback (`null`) so stale refs are not used
- [ ] Max one live canvas per view unchanged

## Regression
- [ ] Cache API `get`/`set`/`invalidate` unchanged
- [ ] Library 3D preview (#145) still mounts shared canvas
- [ ] Headless CI still green without real WebGL (unit mocks + placeholder path)

## Assumptions
- Board thumbs stay on registry `previewUrl` — no cardArt cutover in this ticket
- Snapshot cache remains Play-owned under `features/play/engine3d/rendering/`
- No Feature→Feature imports; extend shared `EnginePreviewCanvas` only with presentational callback

## Security Coverage
- No secrets / network; canvas data stays in-memory data URLs
- No UGC persistence
- Out of scope: P2P, auth, storage backends

## Implementation Notes
- Shared: `EnginePreviewCanvas` exposes `onGlCanvasReady` + `preserveDrawingBuffer: true`
- Play: `EnginePreviewPanel` holds canvas; **Snapshot cachen** calls `requestEngineSnapshot(recipe, { canvas, force: Boolean(canvas) })`
- API: `force` skips cache read so a prior stub can be replaced by a real canvas capture
- DE status: Cache / Canvas-Snapshot / Stub (kein Canvas) / Miss
- Vitest: canvas toDataURL → cache hit; throw → placeholder; force overwrite; miss paths
- Docs: `rendering.md` capture path; `asset-pipeline.md` snapshot notes
- e2e: MVP assembler asserts DE snapshot status text
- No Feature→Feature; board thumbs unchanged (registry previewUrl)
